evaluation_notes: Prefer monetization ideas that strengthen the product's core value loop instead of creating arbitrary paywalls.
A good answer should distinguish between pricing mechanics and packaging strategy.
expected_qualities: Offers a best monetization bet plus at least one conservative and one higher-upside alternative.
Calls out reversal conditions if the pricing model harms activation or trust.

constraints: Maintain a credible self-serve entry point.
Do not depend on enterprise procurement for the next 12 months.
problem_spec.request: Recommend the best monetization strategy for a prosumer product moving upmarket into teams without killing the simplicity that made it spread initially.
success_criteria: Preserve organic adoption and avoid pricing confusion.

title: Pricing and packaging for a prosumer-to-team product
